keywords: Psychology Basics You Need to Know
educationalGoal: Psychology is a field that seeks to scientifically understand the “mind” behind behavior at various levels, from the personal to the social.  The objectives of this course are: (1) to understand the behavior of oneself and others from a psychological perspective and to cultivate insight into human beings, and (2) to link this to personal growth based on the knowledge and skills gained in lectures and discussions on the human mind.
advice:
- History of Psychology
- Mind and Brain
- Sensation and Perception
- Motivational Psychology
- Psychology of Performance
- Psychology of Memory
- Psychology of Personality
- Developmental Psychology
- Social and Group Psychology
- Psychology for Mental and Physical Health

For each of these topics, we will explain fundamental concepts and theories in psychology. Additionally, through exercises and group discussions, we will deepen understanding of the content, connecting it to self-awareness, understanding others, and Self-improvement.

requiredKnowledge:
・You encourage students to have a genuine interest in psychology and to engage in pre-class preparation by reading the textbook to acquire a certain level of background knowledge.
・ Basic skills related to activities such as creating PowerPoint presentations, conducting presentations, and participating in group discussions are necessary, as these exercises are integral to the course.
・ A positive attitude towards deepening self-awareness and understanding others through the classes, as well as an aspirational mindset towards skill development, are desirable.

activityGoals.body: You are able to understand most basic psychological terminology.
You have a better understanding of yourself and others with a psychological perspective.
You are able to use psychological perspectives to deepen your understanding of yourself and others.
You are able to think about yourself and examples from a psychological perspective and explain to others.
You are able to self-evaluate the behavioral objectives to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal:
・To acquire knowledge of psychology and to be able to explain the topics discussed in class.

・To be able to deepen self-understanding and understanding of others through acquisition of knowledge on psychology and exercises in class, and to be able to make practical use of this knowledge.

・Utilize psychological concepts and theories to comprehend individuals and societies, contributing to the generation of new ideas.
achievementLevels.standard:
・To acquire knowledge of psychology and be able to explain to some extent the topics covered in class.

・To be able to deepen self-understanding and understanding of others by acquiring knowledge of psychology and through class exercises.

・Enhance the motivation to utilize psychological concepts and theories to understand individuals and society, contributing to the generation of new ideas.

5.Self-improvement

              Psychology is a field that seeks to scientifically understand the “mind” behind behavior at various levels, from the personal to the social.  The objectives of this course are: (1) to understand the behavior of oneself and others from a psychological perspective and to cultivate insight into human beings, and (2) to link this to personal growth based on the knowledge and skills gained in lectures and discussions on the human mind.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

- History of Psychology
- Mind and Brain
- Sensation and Perception
- Motivational Psychology
- Psychology of Performance
- Psychology of Memory
- Psychology of Personality
- Developmental Psychology
- Social and Group Psychology
- Psychology for Mental and Physical Health

For each of these topics, we will explain fundamental concepts and theories in psychology. Additionally, through exercises and group discussions, we will deepen understanding of the content, connecting it to self-awareness, understanding others, and Self-improvement.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

Textbooks：心理学概論[株式会社サイエンス社]

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              ・You encourage students to have a genuine interest in psychology and to engage in pre-class preparation by reading the textbook to acquire a certain level of background knowledge.
・ Basic skills related to activities such as creating PowerPoint presentations, conducting presentations, and participating in group discussions are necessary, as these exercises are integral to the course.
・ A positive attitude towards deepening self-awareness and understanding others through the classes, as well as an aspirational mindset towards skill development, are desirable.
